proof_body:
by
  intro G X _ _ x y
  by_cases h : x ∈ MulAction.orbit G y
  · exact Or.inl (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr h)
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hx hy
    apply h
    have h1 : MulAction.orbit G z = MulAction.orbit G x := MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hx
    have h2 : MulAction.orbit G z = MulAction.orbit G y := MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hy
    exact MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mp (h1.symm.trans h2)
target_source: ∀ (G X : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x y : X), MulAction.orbit G x = MulAction.orbit G y ∨ Disjoint (MulAction.orbit G x) (MulAction.orbit G y)
